action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage of all legal root moves to find the best plan after Black's ...Nd4.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search; candidate_moves must be empty. Position after 4...Nd4: Black knight on d4 is loose (no pawn defender; only Qd8 defends via d-file? actually c6 knight came to d4, so it's undefended). White's c3 knight is attacked and can capture/exchange or retreat. Need full root scan at depth 3-4 within 3000 nodes.
